title: Calendar
summary: Compact calendar with ICS sync, lunar dates, regional holidays, and almanac.
description: Calendar for CardputerZero with a compact month view, online ICS subscriptions, lunar dates, regional holidays, almanac and weather feeds. Manage optional subscriptions and choose English, Simplified Chinese or Japanese. Use F/Z/X/C to move through dates, Enter to open management and Esc to return; hold Esc to exit. Network access is used only for enabled online calendar feeds; cached data remains available offline.

zh-CN.title: 日历
zh-CN.summary: 支持 ICS 订阅、农历、各地节假日、黄历和天气的便携日历。
zh-CN.description: 在 CardputerZero 上查看月历、农历和订阅日程；节假日、黄历和天气可按需启用。提供中、英、日界面，支持离线缓存。使用 F/Z/X/C 移动日期，Enter 打开管理，短按 Esc 返回，长按 Esc 退出。联网仅用于已启用的在线订阅。
